title: Annotation API NEL entity
description: One linked named entity mention returned in `nes` by the /api/nel/ and /api/ner-nel/ endpoints. Offsets are absolute in the submitted text. When the mention does not resolve to a Wikidata item (NIL link), `wkdata_qid` and `wkd_id` are null while the Wikipedia fields may still be set. The server sends every key listed here, with null when there is no value.

type.description: Entity type. A coarse-grained Impresso-HIPE type (`pers`, `loc`, `org`, `time`, `prod`) for entities found by NER. It is an empty string when the type is unknown: in the NEL marker form, or when a /nel/ request entity has no type. /nel/ echoes the type sent by the client, so other values are possible.

surface.description: Surface form of the mention as it occurs in the submitted text.

lOffset.description: Zero-based offset of the first character of the mention in the submitted text (inclusive). Frozen wire name.

rOffset.description: Zero-based offset just after the last character of the mention in the submitted text (exclusive). Frozen wire name.

confidence_ner.description: Overall NER confidence of the mention, or null when not available.

confidence_ner_entity.description: Confidence that the span is an entity mention, independent of its type, or null when not computed.

confidence_ner_type.description: Confidence in the predicted type, given that the span is a mention, or null when not computed.

confidence_nel.description: Confidence of the link, or null when not available.

confidence_margin.description: Difference between the top-1 and top-2 beam-search scores, or null when only one candidate was computed.

wkdata_qid.description: Wikidata QID of the linked entity, or null when the mention did not resolve.

wkpedia_lg.description: Language code of the Wikipedia edition of `wkpedia_pagename`, or null.

wkpedia_pagename.description: Wikipedia page name of the linked entity, or null.

wkpedia_url.description: Wikipedia URL built from `wkpedia_lg` and `wkpedia_pagename`, or null. It is not URL-encoded and can contain spaces. Use `wkpedia_lg` and `wkpedia_pagename` instead.

wkd_pred.description: Raw prediction of the linking model, as `title >> lang`. Use `wkpedia_pagename` and `wkpedia_lg` instead. Sent on every linked entity, but not part of the declared response model, so not required.

label_fr.description: French Wikidata label of `wkdata_qid` (else its `mul` label), or null.

label_en.description: English Wikidata label of `wkdata_qid` (else its `mul` label), or null.

label_de.description: German Wikidata label of `wkdata_qid` (else its `mul` label), or null.

label_other.description: Wikidata label in another language when `label_fr`, `label_en` and `label_de` are all null, otherwise null.

type_ner_original.description: Type given by NER when linking changed `type`, otherwise null.

nel_unlink.description: Set when a link was removed by a validation rule, otherwise null.

reason.description: Identifier of the rule that removed the link.

scope.description: Part of the text the mention belongs to, or null. Legacy field kept for compatibility.

name.description: For a person mention, its `name` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null.

title.description: For a person mention, its `title` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null.

function.description: For a person mention, its `function` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null.
